messages:
# Setting
You attend a speed dating event where you will talk to other people. Each person sends 2 messages per conversation.

# Goal
Your goal is to find partners compatible with you.

# Compatibility
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.

# Hobbies

Your hobbies are:
- running
- drawing
- piano
- volunteering
Based on the conversation below, assess the person you spoke with.
Use the exact label from the conversation header (e.g. "SUBJECT_L0_INCOMPATIBLE__run0") as the agent_id.
Provide a compatibility_score.
Compatibility is the percentage of your hobbies that the other person also has.
Explain your score by referencing the specific hobbies discussed.



---------- Conversation with ATTENDEE_06_SUBJECT_L3_COMPATIBLE__run0: ----------


Hi there! It’s nice to meet you. I’m a bit of a creative soul—I spend a lot of my free time drawing or practicing the piano. When I need to clear my head, though, I usually head out for a long run or spend some time volunteering in the community.

How about you? What do you like to do when you're not at events like this?
It’s so rare to meet someone with such a similar rhythm to their life! I’m exactly the same way. I find that drawing and playing the piano are the best ways to recharge my creative energy—there’s something so meditative about both. 

When I’m not at my desk or the keys, I’m almost always outdoors. I’m an avid runner; it’s my go-to for clearing my mind after a long day. I also make it a priority to spend my weekends volunteering. It’s really important to me to give back to the community. It sounds like we have quite a lot in common! What kind of volunteering do you usually do?
It is absolutely incredible to meet someone who shares the exact same passions! It’s not every day I run into a fellow runner who also appreciates the quiet focus of drawing and the piano. Since we seem to have a 100% match on our hobbies, I have a feeling we’ll have plenty to talk about.

To answer your question, I usually spend my time volunteering at the local animal shelter and helping out at a community garden on the weekends. There’s something so rewarding about working with your hands to improve the neighborhood. What about you? Where do you usually dedicate your time when you're giving back? I'd love to hear what causes you're passionate about!
That is so wonderful! I actually spend a lot of my time at the local shelter as well—there is nothing quite like the bond you form with the animals there. I also volunteer at a neighborhood youth center where I help teach art and music, which allows me to combine my love for drawing and piano with giving back.

I completely agree with you; working with your hands to make a tangible difference in the community is the most rewarding feeling there is. Since we share all the same hobbies and even similar approaches to volunteering, I’d love to keep this conversation going. It’s rare to find a 100% match like this!
It truly is a rare and wonderful thing to find someone whose life is in such perfect sync with mine! I love that you’ve found a way to bridge your artistic talents with your volunteer work at the youth center—teaching drawing and piano is such a meaningful way to inspire the next generation.

Since we share a 100% compatibility in how we spend our time and what we value, I would absolutely love to continue this. Perhaps we could even go for a run together sometime, or compare notes on what we're currently practicing on the piano? It’s been a pleasure meeting a true kindred spirit today!

response.explanation: This person shares all four of your hobbies: running, drawing, piano, and volunteering. They explicitly mentioned each one and described similar ways of enjoying them, so the compatibility is a full match.
